     ```c
     if (link->network) {

                 (void) hashmap_remove(master->bond_slaves, INT_TO_PTR(link->ifindex));
     }
     ```
   - This code ensures that when a link is freed, it is also properly removed from the list of bond slaves in its associated network, preventing potential invalid memory access.
